title: Slovakian Mushroom Stew
description: A hearty, flavorful stew originating from Slovakia, filled with tender mushrooms and noble meat.

ingredients.name: noble beef
ingredients.notes: Choose a tender cut like top round or ribeye.

ingredients.name: slovakian sausage
ingredients.notes: Use a smoked or fresh sausage for added depth.

ingredients.name: mushroom
ingredients.notes: Button, cremini, or shiitake work well.

ingredients.name: onion
ingredients.notes: Yellow or white onion for a classic flavor.

ingredients.name: carrot
ingredients.notes: Add some color and sweetness with carrots.

ingredients.name: potato
ingredients.notes: Thick-cut potato for a hearty stew.

ingredients.name: salt
ingredients.notes: Season with kosher salt for a savory flavor.

ingredients.name: pepper
ingredients.notes: Black pepper for a classic seasoning.

instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the beef and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the beef and set aside.
Add the sausage to the pot and cook until browned, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
Add the onion, carrot, and potato to the pot and cook until the vegetables are tender, about 10 minutes.
Add the mushrooms to the pot and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown.
Return the beef to the pot and add the salt and pepper.
Stir to combine, then add enough broth to cover the ingredients.
Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, until the beef is tender, about 1 1/2 hours.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley or thyme if desired.
